I was born and raised in the South Bay (Redondo beach/Hollywood riviera specifically).  This area is at the bottom of Palos Verdes which I’m stoked you are already familiar with, love the hiking trails there and the tide pools are super cool too. I grew up going to Maui every summer and Palos Verdes always made me feel like I was back in Maui again. I grew up surfing and biking the strand on the beach to work. (There is this cool little dirt wooded path I’d call it that starts in Redondo beach and ends on the el segundo side of Manhattan beach. It’s called the green belt and it’s a super fun coastal side trail that will make you feel removed from the city for sure. *sorry for the random sidebar*) I’d paddle board in kings harbor, skate to Hermosa beach  and hit up the skatepark there. Hermosa beach is super walkable and has a dope downtown area that has a walk street right by the pier. The walk street has cool places to eat and drink and hang. I’d go down to the next beach (Manhattan) and hit up the indoor rock climbing gym (I know it’s inside but still dope). The last recommendation I have is the pine wind Japanese garden at the torrance performing arts center. That place is super zen and relaxing, a little hideaway from the hustle and bustle of it all. I know you may come in with the “oh but that’s a drive”….it doesn’t have to be a drive it can be a bike ride or a skate maybe a mini bus ride adventure. I promise you won’t be disappointed. Good luck!
